suitable.title: Blondie Bar
suitable.ingredients: Let’s get this party started! When chocolate and white chocolate chips get to mingling in a sweet vanilla setting, it’s true what they say: Blondies really do have more fun. This bar is guilt free with 160 calories and will keep you having fun all day with 12g fiber.

suitable.title: Blueberry Cobbler
suitable.ingredients: A sweet moment of bliss, so the only blues you feel will be bursting with berry. The dessert flavored bar contains 12g fiber with only 150 calories. Grab dessert, any time you desire.

suitable.title: Brownie Crunch
suitable.ingredients: Dessert disguised as protein? Don’t mind if we do. NuGo Slim Brownie Crunch gives you the better-for-you brownie moment you deserve: gluten free, 16g protein, just 3g sugar, no artificial sweeteners, & premium, rich REAL Dark Chocolate.

suitable.title: Chocolate Almond
suitable.ingredients: This bar has it all: irresistible dark chocolate, roasted almonds and a sprinkle of sea salt. Every bite of NuGo Dark Chocolate Almond with Sea Salt is crunchy, nutty, and the perfect combination of salty and sweet. Satisfy your undeniable cravings with this Gluten Free and Vegan snack that includes 12g of protein and real Non-GMO ingredients.

suitable.title: Chocolate Banana
suitable.ingredients: Go bananas for our delicious combination natural banana flavor and creamy, real milk chocolate. NuGo Chocolate Banana bars are certified gluten free and loaded with vitamins and minerals. With 13g protein and just 4g of fat, this tasty treat is the perfect way to start your day.

suitable.title: Chocolate Black Cherry
suitable.ingredients: Smarte Nutrition - with a cherry on top. Try a low carb, Smarte Carb protein bar in Chocolate Black Cherry for an indulgent treat without the guilt. These bars contain 0g sugar and 18g protein - a delicious choice for those with dietary restrictions. PLEASE NOTE: Packaging may vary while we transition to our new look.

suitable.title: Chocolate Brownie
suitable.ingredients: Decadent nutrition coming at you in this crave-worthy Fiber d'Lish bar. With a perfect blend of dark cocoa and real dark chocolate chips, fiber never tasted so good. Fiber d'Lish Chocolate Brownie contains 12g fiber with only 150 calories to help keep you full and satisfied. So go ahead, embrace your dark side!

suitable.title: Chocolate Cherry
suitable.ingredients: Ready for a bar that’s more boutique chocolate counter than everyday snack? NuGo Dark Chocolate Cherry is pure chocolate-cherry temptation that’s certified vegan, gluten free, and OU Kosher Pareve with 12 plant protein. Yeah, this one knows it’s good.

suitable.title: Chocolate Chocolate Chip
suitable.ingredients: There’s no such thing as too much chocolate. NuGo Dark Chocolate Chip is filled with rich chocolate chips and coated in real dark chocolate made with cocoa butter - never palm oil. With 12g of plant-based protein and the perfect crunch, it’s everything you want in a snack: gluten free, OU kosher pareve, vegan, and undeniably delicious.

suitable.title: Chocolate Coconut
suitable.ingredients: Send your cravings on vacation with the simple sweetness of coconut and the indulgent flavor of real dark chocolate. This tropical duo comes together in the irresistible NuGo Dark Chocolate Coconut bar. Each bar contains gluten free, vegan and OU Kosher pareve ingredients. Throw in 10g of protein, and now you're in paradise!

suitable.title: Chocolate Pretzel
suitable.ingredients: Life is full of hard choices, choosing between salty and sweet shouldn't be one of them. The delicious flavor of rich dark chocolate sprinkled with sea salt combined with the satisfying crunch of pretzels will please all your senses. Each NuGo Dark bar has 12g plant protein and is certified gluten free, vegan and OU Kosher Pareve. It's no wonder this is our best-selling NuGo bar.

suitable.title: Churro
suitable.ingredients: Introducing the New, NuGo Original Churro bar! Crispy, crunchy, and irresistibly delicious, it's the guilt-free snack you've been craving. Imagine the classic taste of a cinnamon sugar churro paired with the protein-packed goodness of a protein bar. With 15 grams of protein and a creamy vanilla yogurt layer, each bite delivers a wholesome burst of flavor. Made with real ingredients, it's the perfect on-the-go indulgence to satisfy your cravings without compromise.

suitable.title: Cinnamon Raisin
suitable.ingredients: The oatmeal raisin cookie has met its match! But don't let your taste buds fool you: each Fiber d'Lish Cinnamon Raisin bar contains 12g fiber and just 150 calories. So chewy and full of plump raisins, it's the perfect way to start your day. Now you really can have cookies for breakfast.

suitable.title: Coffee
suitable.ingredients: No time for breakfast? NuGo Coffee bar has the perfect blend of delicious coffee flavor and creamy, real milk chocolate to get your day started the right way. This certified gluten free bar is low in fat, high in protein and loaded with vitamins and minerals. Breakfast doesn't get much better!

suitable.title: Crunchy Peanut Butter
suitable.ingredients: Like spoonfuls of peanut butter straight from the jar - without the mess. Enjoy sweet, creamy peanut butter and indulgent real dark chocolate in a take-it-anywhere bar that is vegan and gluten-free. With just 3g of sugar and 16g vegan protein, NuGo Slim Crunchy Peanut Butter is a must-have for all peanut butter lovers. As always, NuGo Slim® contains no Maltitol or artificial sweeteners.

suitable.title: Dark Chocolate Almond
suitable.ingredients: Dark Chocolate Almond, the name says it all! Made with real dark chocolate and crunchy almonds, this certified organic bar has maximum goodness in every bite. All NuGo Organic® bars are also vegan, gluten free, wholesome and delicious. What's not to love?

suitable.title: Dark Chocolate Cherry Pomegranate
suitable.ingredients: Sweeten your day! NuGo Organic® Dark Chocolate Pomegranate features a delicious blend of decadent real dark chocolate and tangy pomegranate for an indulgence that is purely delicious. Made with organic, vegan and gluten free ingredients, this wholesome snack bar with 10g protein is too sweet to pass on!

suitable.title: Double Dark Chocolate
suitable.ingredients: Pure. Chocolate. Heaven. Why settle for just chocolate when you can have double chocolate? Indulge in decadent real dark chocolate with a dash of sea salt. Our NuGo Organic Double Dark Chocolate bars are made with organic, vegan and gluten-free ingredients, and packed with 10g plant protein.

suitable.title: Dulce de Leche
suitable.ingredients: A twist on tradition - and one you’ll crave daily. Inspired by the rich, traditional Hispanic dessert, NuGo Original Dulce de Leche layers creamy caramel flavor and 15g protein. It’s crispy. It’s crunchy. It’s certified gluten free. It’s about to become your new favorite.

suitable.title: Espresso
suitable.ingredients: A coffee lover's dream. Upgrade your next coffee break with NuGo Slim Espresso, made with real coffee beans and indulgent real dark chocolate. This vegan, gluten free bar contains only 3g sugar and 16g protein. Not too sweet and balanced to perfection. Ditch the mocha latte and reach for NuGo Slim Espresso.

suitable.title: Milk Chocolate
suitable.ingredients: Meet the bar that started it all. We set the bar high when we created this original bar. Made with creamy, real milk chocolate, NuGo Chocolate bars are a nutritious and delicious snack for the whole family. This certified gluten free bar is low in fat, high in protein and loaded with vitamins and minerals. Please refer to the physical wrapper for the most up-to-date information.

suitable.title: Mint Chocolate Chip
suitable.ingredients: No need to “scout” out your favorite mint cookies. NuGo Dark Mint Chocolate Chip is like a thin mint but has all the benefits of a vegan protein bar. Go ahead and enjoy the perfect blend of chocolate minty goodness. This gluten free, vegan bar with 13g protein will satisfy any craving without compromise.

suitable.title: Mocha Chocolate
suitable.ingredients: Coffee lovers, this one's for you! There's nothing like the delicious combination of decadent real dark chocolate and creamy coffee flavor to start your day off right. NuGo Dark Mocha Chocolate bars pack 11g plant protein and are gluten free, vegan, and OU Kosher Pareve. A great sweet treat any time of day!

suitable.title: NuGo Dark
suitable.ingredients: All NuGo Dark bars contain no artificial ingredients, no artificial sweeteners, no maltitol, and no palm oil

suitable.title: NuGo Original 2 pack Churro and Dulce de Leche
suitable.ingredients: Inspired by beloved Hispanic desserts, NuGo Original Churro and NuGo Original Dulce de Leche bars bring indulgence and 15g of protein to every bite. One blends warm cinnamon-sugar with a crispy crunch; the other layers creamy caramel flavor that melts into every crisp. Both are certified gluten free with 15g protein. Both are irresistibly satisfying. Together, they’re your new favorite duo.

suitable.title: NuGo Plant Protein Powders
suitable.ingredients: Introducing NuGo Plant Protein, the newest NuGo product! This silky-smooth product packs 20g of premium North American pea protein, MCT oil and only 3g sugar. NuGo Plant Protein stands out as the best-tasting protein powder on the market. It blends smoothly and has minimal ingredients. Both delicious rich flavors are Certified Gluten Free, Vegan, and Non-GMO.

suitable.title: NuGo Slim
suitable.ingredients: Say goodbye to unhealthy alternatives and say hello to guilt-free Real Dark Chocolate covered low sugar protein bars. NuGo Slim is low sugar, low carbs and high in protein. NuGo Slim has no artificial ingredients, no maltitol, and is certified gluten free and 4 flavors are vegan and Kosher Pareve. LOW SUGAR &amp; HIGH PROTEIN: With only 2-3g of sugar in each 16-18g protein bar, no artificial sweeteners and no maltitol, NuGo Slim is a guilt-free way of getting the protein you need, the ultimate low sugar high protein bar. LOW-GLYCEMIC: NuGo Slim was tested by GI Labs of Toronto, CA as a very low glycemic index. No other low sugar protein bar is certified and tested low glycemic. Slim helps to slow your metabolism, curb cravings and avoid sugar spikes making it one of the best low glycemic snacks on the market. CERTIFIED VEGAN: 4 flavors - Crunchy Peanut Butter, Chocolate Mint, Toasted Coconut, and Espresso - are certified vegan, with 16-18g of plant-based protein in every snack bar. No whey protein, zero lactose, just Non-GMO plant protein. HIGH FIBER &amp; LOW CARB: NuGo Slim contains 6-7g of Fiber and 5-7g of net carbs making it the perfect low carb protein bar. CERTIFIED GLUTEN FREE: NuGo Slim protein bars contain only certified gluten free ingredients.

suitable.title: Orange Smoothie
